title: Grilled Salmon with Wavy Fries
description: A simple yet flavorful dish featuring grilled salmon paired with crispy wavy fries. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
Grill the salmon for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, cut the wavy potatoes into fry shapes.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the wavy potatoes to the pan and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the grilled salmon with wavy fries.
